'''Droid Zero''' was a [[V6-series pilot droid]].

==History==
Droid Zero developed a superiority complex, which overode some of the behavioural inhibitors built into its core programming and eventually led to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] believing that it was demeaning for droids to serve [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. After being assigned to a [[Senate|senatorial]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Droid Zero infected the ship's entire complement of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] with its programming, then transferred to a new ship and repeated the process a number of times. As a result, there became dozens of infected droids across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which started directing their owners' starships into hazardous areas. Government droid technicians began scouring the galaxy to try and find Droid Zero, but the droid continued to spread its programming.
